name: ddd-plugin-dev
description: AI-DLC v2 DDD プラグインの開発用設定。

scripts.build:all: bun run build:claude && bun run build:codex
scripts.check: bun run check:biome && bun run validate && bun run test
scripts.test:sandbox: bun run test:coverage && bun run build:all && for h in claude codex; do bun ../.codex/tools/aidlc-plugin-test.ts . --install .. --harness $h || exit 1; done && bun scripts/verify-dist.ts && bun test tests/t1-gate-integration.test.ts
scripts.test:coverage: bun test tests/t8-declaration-language.test.ts tests/t9-sensor-contract.test.ts && bun scripts/report-sensor-coverage.ts
